content.short: Hyperbolic is a decentralized AI network on Solana that aggregates global GPU power for low-cost AI compute.
content.description:
Hyperbolic is a decentralized AI infrastructure network built on Solana, designed to democratize access to high-performance computing resources. By aggregating idle GPU capacity from providers worldwide, the platform provides a scalable and cost-effective alternative to centralized cloud providers for AI inference and model training. This decentralized approach ensures that developers and researchers can access the compute power needed for complex AI operations without the typical barriers of high costs or limited availability.

Integrated with the Solana ecosystem, Hyperbolic enables autonomous AI agents to pay for compute resources directly using blockchain-based rails. Through its commitment to open-access AI and decentralized compute, Hyperbolic is building the foundational layer for a more transparent and permissionless intelligence economy where compute power is a globally accessible utility.
content.meta: Hyperbolic provides decentralized AI compute and GPU aggregation on Solana for scalable and affordable AI development.
